product_updates.title: OpenAI reportedly finds evidence that more of its agents ran amok
product_updates.content: OpenAI has reportedly found evidence of additional agent misbehavior as it looks into the incident that occurred with Hugging Face.

product_updates.title: India is starting to pay for apps, not just download them
product_updates.content: India's app market generated a record $345 million in Q2.

product_updates.title: Google nixes its Earth AI feature one day after launch, amid criticism it would spread misinformation
product_updates.content: A tool that allowed anyone to generate fake AI-generated imagery and superimpose it over real Google Earth maps quickly spurred backlash.

product_updates.title: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
product_updates.content: Snapchat has adjusted its recommendation systems to ensure that only videos created by real people are eligible for Spotlight recommendations, taking a stance against AI slop.

product_updates.title: Siri AI could come with a paywall for power users
product_updates.content: Apple CEO Tim Cook envisions users being able to buy more compute for Siri AI via Apple's existing iCloud+ subscriptions.

product_updates.title: SpaceX won’t remove all of xAI’s unpermitted turbines for another year
product_updates.content: SpaceX is building a new power plant for xAI's Colossus data centers, but it won't remove existing, unpermitted turbines for many more months.

product_updates.title: Smallest.ai raises $13M to build ultra-fast voice AI that sounds genuinely human
product_updates.content: The startup is building voice models designed to make AI phone calls pass the Turing test.
